decisions.reason: Displaying identical placard wording on both sides does not change the machine's DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The placard-side and viewing-orientation change does not alter the approved beige and green color treatment.
The source changes only the branded placard and does not modify the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication method.
Facing the placard toward both baristas and customers does not change the spout's barista-facing orientation.
The two-sided placard decision has no necessary effect on splash-control behavior or mitigation.
The placard display change does not affect controlled pouring, drip prevention, flow quality, or beverage preservation.
The source does not change the solenoid valve or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
The placard wording and orientation do not alter bowl depth, capacity, or refilling expectations.
Adding identical wording to both sides of the placard does not necessarily change the enclosure's size or proportions.
The placard display change is unrelated to whisk height, foam performance, or splash-minimizing positioning.
The source does not modify the whisk's dimensions, material, or selected design.
The two-sided placard requirement does not affect bowl removal, clearance, or swapping behavior.
